[P2] Preserve the wrapper-return fallback for ambiguous decisions

Two distinct `invocation_end` observations cause this helper to discard the suspension entirely. The documented contract and `rules/replay.py::_pending_decision_times` instead fall back to the wrapper-return timestamp. Consequently, a wait completing after that return can incorrectly produce `durableWaitObserved: false` and `suspensionCheckpointMatches: false`; callback selection also fails. Initialize the decision to the wrapper return and override it only for one valid, in-range PENDING observation. Add source-normalization coverage for duplicate and out-of-range observations.
